handbook: (Handbook 2025) Travel reimbursement requests must be filed in the portal within 30 days of the trip.
(Handbook 2025) Portal accounts are locked after 5 failed password attempts.
(Notice, March 2026) Starting in March 2026, travel reimbursement requests must be filed within 15 days of the trip. This replaces the 30-day rule.
(Handbook 2025) The support desk answers on business days, from 8 am to 6 pm.
(Handbook 2025) The Lisbon office has 40 parking spaces; the Porto office has 25.
(Handbook 2025) Laptops are replaced every 4 years and monitors every 6 years.
(Handbook 2025) The Lisboa Street warehouse, which is not the Lisbon office, opens at 6 am.
(Security policy 2026) Passwords must have at least 14 characters.
